status: DRAFT — UNSIGNED (automated execution; human review and signature outstanding)

body.anaDetail: No AI provider is configured. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or AI_BEDROCK_ENABLED / AI_VERTEX_ENABLED) — without one, every AnA turn returns 503 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE. OPENAI_API_KEY or KIMI_API_KEY alone answer chat but not regulatory drafting, which only an approvedForHighRisk model may serve.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: request review on a review route naming the second identity; the route refuses what it may not name; submit the document into its approval workflow (before freeze — submit requires DRAFT)
steps.action: GET /documents/:id/route-candidates; POST /documents/:id/request-review naming OQ_SIGNER with no reason, then with a reason and no route; naming the run identity (the author) with a reason and route {reviewDueDate}; GET /documents/:id/reviews and GET /documents/:id/review-route after each; POST /documents/:id/request-review {reviewers:[OQ_SIGNER], reason, route:{reviewDueDate}}; GET …/review-route; the same request again; POST /docs/:id/submit {workflow_steps:[{role:"QA"}]}; with approver_email = self; GET /docs/:id/workflow
steps.expected: The candidates read refuses the run identity as reviewer, MEMBER_IS_AUTHOR, and offers OQ_SIGNER. No reason 400 REASON_REQUIRED; no route 400 ROUTE_DUE_DATES_REQUIRED; the author named 409 REVIEWER_IS_AUTHOR; after each, no review request and no route. Naming OQ_SIGNER 200: a pending review request for OQ_SIGNER, and a route (added false) with one task, OQ_SIGNER's, with its due date; the route reads open, round 1, sent by the run identity with the reason, OQ_SIGNER its one reviewer, pending at their turn, with a due date. Naming OQ_SIGNER again 409 MEMBER_ALREADY_NAMED, the route unchanged. Submit without approver_email 400; with it the document moves to IN_REVIEW and the workflow lists a PENDING step. Without OQ_SIGNER_* the step is recorded "not executed — credential not supplied".
steps.observed: author refused (MEMBER_IS_AUTHOR in candidates; REVIEWER_IS_AUTHOR on request); no reason, no route refused with nothing written; route 7286531a-82be-47df-ae15-e0e295aff17e names oq-signer@validation.local (task ROUTE-7286531a-2, due 2026-11-17T23:59:59.999Z); naming again refused MEMBER_ALREADY_NAMED; submit w/o approver → 400; workflow: {"success":true,"workflowId":"077286fc-319e-413b-8437-93653954a0b9","steps":[{"workflow_id":"077286fc-319e-413b-8437-93653954a0b9","doc_id":"fdc9cecb-3058-4434-
steps.note: Revised in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5): until v0.4 the run identity named itself, with no reason and no route, which RR5 refuses 400 REASON_REQUIRED (red record). The author is refused twice over: by the request's own independence check (REVIEWER_IS_AUTHOR, server/services/authoring/peer-review.ts), which answers first, and by the route's one member validator (MEMBER_IS_AUTHOR, server/services/review/review-route-member.ts), whose answer the candidates read shows.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the named reviewer sees the review awaiting them on the Review surface and in their work
steps.action: As OQ_SIGNER, after the request and submit above: GET /api/review/board (the read model behind /concept2cure/review); GET /api/review/board?scope=mine; GET /api/tasks/my-work
steps.expected: The queue lists the document for the reviewer, awaiting their review (awaitingMyReview true, no review signature); the "mine" scope lists it; their work lists their route task, as a reviewer's
steps.observed: queue lists the document awaiting oq-signer@validation.local; in "mine"; task ROUTE-7286531a-2 (pending) in their work
steps.note: Revised in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5): the reviewer is OQ_SIGNER, whom the route names; until v0.4 it was the run identity. F-6 (VSR-001 §11.2) is why this step exists: the Review board reads the authoring review store, and since RR5 also each document's route (server/services/review/authoring-review-board.ts).

steps.title: AI drafting fails closed when no provider is configured
steps.expected: No draft content is returned; the request is refused with a provider-unavailable status (5xx) — never a fabricated draft
steps.observed: HTTP 503: {"success":false,"error":{"code":"GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE","message":"No AI provider is configured for this deployment, so this section cannot be drafted. Nothing was changed."}}
steps.note: Executed BEFORE the freeze (OQ-AUTH-11a/11): once the document is FROZEN every edit-class route is refused 409 AUTHORING_DOCUMENT_IMMUTABLE, which would answer this step for the wrong reason and mask F-10. v0.6: the request names its writing region. Since 8013c94575 (2026-10-30) a draft of a section with no recorded receiving jurisdiction is refused 409 DRAFT_REGION_REQUIRED before the provider is asked, which answered this step before the check it exists for.

steps.title: AI drafting produces a governed draft candidate
steps.expected: A draft candidate with provenance is returned for human acceptance: the model that wrote it, its filed AnA turn record, and the answer check of the draft against the evidence the model was shown

error.message: No AI provider is configured for this deployment, so this section cannot be drafted. Nothing was changed.

steps.note: The turn record (services/ana/turn-record-draft.ts) holds the prompt sent, the model, the gateway request and the check; the parked candidate names it, and the accept's trail row carries both ids (generator.turnRecordId, generator.requestId). v0.6: the request names its writing region, as OQ-AUTH-15's does.
steps.deviationReason: AnA unavailable: no provider configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY unset in this environment). Re-execute with a PQ-passed model configured.

steps.title: Freeze is refused while a review comment is unresolved (negative case)
steps.action: POST /api/authoring/docs/:id/freeze {reason, version:"1.0", meaning:"AUTHOR"} while the OQ-AUTH-09 comment is open; GET /docs/:id/frozen
steps.expected: HTTP 409 DOCUMENT_NOT_SETTLED naming 1 unresolved comment; nothing frozen (no content hash retrievable)
steps.observed: HTTP 409 DOCUMENT_NOT_SETTLED (openComments=1, pendingEdits=0); frozen read → HTTP 404, no content hash
steps.note: VSR-001 §8.3 P-1: the baseline protocol froze over an open comment and recorded the refusal as a failure. The refusal is the required fail-closed behaviour; this step keeps it as the negative case. The "acknowledgeUnresolved" confirm flag is deliberately NOT used as the happy path.

steps.title: Resolve the review comment through the comment-resolution API; the resolution is audited
steps.expected: HTTP 200; comment status resolved with resolved_by = actor and resolved_at set; the audit trail carries a comment_resolved event naming the comment
steps.observed: comment 388aa4b7-dbb9-4cd1-a9fc-c985d4b8a6cf resolved by oq-runner@validation.local at 2026-11-10T02:48:37.266Z; audit event comment_resolved by oq-runner@validation.local

steps.title: Freeze the settled document into an immutable snapshot, signed by the ceremony
steps.action: POST /api/authoring/docs/:id/freeze {reason, version:"1.0", meaning:"AUTHOR", password, mfaToken (current code)} after the comment is resolved; GET /docs/:id/frozen
steps.expected: HTTP 200 with a signatureId; a frozen record with content_hash is retrievable; a second freeze is refused

steps.title: A signing PIN signs nothing, and no route sets one
steps.action: POST /api/authoring/users/pin {pin}; as the route's named reviewer (OQ_SIGNER) POST /docs/:id/e-sign {pin, meaning:"REVIEWER", intent} with no password
steps.expected: 404 for the PIN route; 400 PASSWORD_REQUIRED for the PIN-only signature; no signature stored beyond the OQ-AUTH-11 freeze's own
steps.observed: PIN route → 404; the reviewer's PIN-only signature → 400 PASSWORD_REQUIRED; no signature stored
steps.note: Revised in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5): the PIN-only signature is attempted by the named reviewer. The run identity, whom the route does not name, is refused ROUTE_NOT_NAMED before any credential (OQ-AUTH-13b), which would answer this step for the wrong reason.

steps.title: E-signature refuses a wrong password, a missing code and an invalid meaning
steps.action: POST /docs/:id/e-sign as the route's named reviewer (OQ_SIGNER) with (a) a wrong password, (b) their password and no code (identity with an authenticator enrolled); (c) as the run identity with meaning "WHATEVER"; (d) as the named reviewer with meaning "WHATEVER"
steps.expected: (a) 401 PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_FAILED; (b) 400 MFA_TOKEN_REQUIRED; (c) 400 Invalid signature meaning; (d) 403 AUTHORING_OBJECT_FORBIDDEN; no signature stored beyond the OQ-AUTH-11 freeze's own
steps.observed: wrong password → 401; no code → 400 MFA_TOKEN_REQUIRED; bad meaning → 400 (run identity), 403 AUTHORING_OBJECT_FORBIDDEN (reviewer); no signature stored
steps.note: Revised in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5): (a) and (b) are executed by the named reviewer, for the reason OQ-AUTH-12 gives. (c) stays the run identity's: the object gate judges an e-sign whose meaning is not REVIEWER as an approval-class act (server/middleware/authoringObjectAuthorization.ts), which the run identity's access admits, so the request reaches the meaning check; a Reviewer grant does not admit it, so (d), the same request from the named reviewer, is refused at the gate.

steps.title: On a live review route, a REVIEWER signature from a person the route does not name is refused before the credential
steps.action: As the run identity (the author, whom the route does not name): POST /docs/:id/e-sign {password, meaning:"REVIEWER", intent} with no code; GET /docs/:id/signatures; GET /documents/:id/review-route
steps.expected: 403 ROUTE_NOT_NAMED — not 400 MFA_TOKEN_REQUIRED, which the same request from the named reviewer answered in OQ-AUTH-13: the route answers before the credential is read; no signature stored beyond the OQ-AUTH-11 freeze's own; the route open, its reviewer still pending
steps.observed: 403 ROUTE_NOT_NAMED before the credential; no signature stored; the route open, its reviewer pending
steps.note: New in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5, §2.8; authoringReviewerPrecheck in server/services/authoring/authoring-review-route.ts). Until v0.4 the run identity signed REVIEWER on its own document (OQ-AUTH-14).

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the route's named reviewer applies a REVIEWER e-signature, re-verified by the ceremony and bound to the frozen snapshot
steps.action: As OQ_SIGNER: GET /api/review/board; POST /docs/:id/e-sign {password, mfaToken (current code), meaning:"REVIEWER", intent}; GET /docs/:id/signatures
steps.expected: Before the signature the queue lists the document awaiting OQ_SIGNER's review. HTTP 200; two signatures — the OQ-AUTH-11 freeze (AUTHOR) and this one, with signer_email = OQ_SIGNER (the named reviewer), meaning REVIEWER, method password+mfa (password for an identity with no authenticator), pin_verified false, signature_digest and covered_content_hash present
steps.observed: signature af054f9b-f043-4029-8a33-c6cbf2fea461 by oq-signer@validation.local, meaning REVIEWER, method password+mfa, covers freeze v1.0 (d5b58fe055ba…)
steps.note: Revised in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5): the signer is the person the route names; until v0.4 it was the run identity, the document's author, which OQ-AUTH-13b now shows refused.

steps.title: CREDENTIALED: the review signature closes the reviewer's route task and completes the route; the Review board no longer has it awaiting them
steps.action: GET /documents/:id/review-route; as OQ_SIGNER: GET /api/tasks/my-work, GET /api/review/board, GET /api/review/board?scope=mine
steps.expected: The route reads complete, its one reviewer signed with the OQ-AUTH-14 signature (meaning REVIEWER, their printed name); their route task is no longer in their open work; the queue row reads awaitingMyReview false with the signature's time (myReviewSignedAt, and routeSignedAt on their review request); the "mine" scope no longer lists the document
steps.observed: route 7286531a-82be-47df-ae15-e0e295aff17e complete; OQ Signer signed (af054f9b-f043-4029-8a33-c6cbf2fea461); task ROUTE-7286531a-2 closed; queue: awaitingMyReview false, signed 2026-11-10T02:49:00.353Z; not in "mine"
steps.note: New in OQ-003 v0.5 (RR5, §2.8; closeAuthoringReviewerTask in server/services/authoring/authoring-review-route.ts, signedOnRoute in shared/authoring/peer-review.ts). The document stays on the queue: its approval workflow step (OQ-AUTH-17) is still pending.

steps.title: The template library is outside this release; the global reference answers
steps.expected: The library 403 LAUNCH_SCOPE; the global reference 200 with a list payload
steps.note: v0.6: the template library left the launch scope by the CPO decision of 2026-10-08 (bcc457edb8, docs/SURFACE_DECISIONS_2026-10-08.md): a saved template formats no authored document. Until v0.5 the step expected 200 from both stores. URS-AUTH-014's organisation store is withdrawn from this release; its revision is owed through change control.
